description: On-chain facilitator for x402-style agent payments on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.30.1): a facilitator authority registers merchants, settles agent token payments with a protocol fee taken into a fee vault, records off-chain x402 settlements, withdraws fees and deregisters merchants. initialize, register_merchant, settle_payment, record_x402_settlement, withdraw_fees and deregister_merchant were verified with lab tokens.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of ds1/pincerpay. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/pincerpay. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (merchant registry, fee settlement, x402 records)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/pincerpay/
QA: devnet proof of facilitated agent payments
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Find why the default SBF build overflows in settle_payment
